content.tex: On the same diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = x^{2}\) for \(-2 \leqslant x \leqslant 2\) .
The equation \(\frac{1}{1-x^{3}} = x^{2}\) can be written in the form \(x^{u} -x^{w} +1 = 0\) .
Find the value of \(u\) and the value of \(w\) .
